full.description: This is a clinical photograph of an infant's head and upper back, displaying a prominent congenital neural tube defect. A large, open lesion at the posterior of the head reveals exposed neural tissue and hemorrhage. This presentation is characteristic of a severe form of spina bifida, such as anencephaly or a large encephalocele. The image also includes a metric scale ruler placed alongside the infant's back for measurement purposes.
